verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS directory, gateway and hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Glama hosting users' MCP servers on its own infrastructure (GitHub, Dockerfile, npm or PyPI deploys), and using mcp-proxy to tunnel local servers to Glama's hosted inspector. Nothing documents a deployable or self-hostable distribution of Glama's own directory, gateway or chat.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
